name: fpr_release_under_pressure
display_name: Guest pressure below the release line is answered
description: Safety contract: with pages held, guest pressure through the release line is answered - allocations keep succeeding and available settles back above the line

test_steps.guest_run: Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\BALLOON\Parameters' -Name EnableFpr -Value 1 -Type DWord; Write-Output 'PASS: EnableFpr=1 set'

test_steps.desc: Restart balloon device to negotiate the feature
Let the hold take the free memory first
test_steps.guest_run: $os = Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem; $totalMb = [math]::Round($os.TotalVisibleMemorySize / 1KB); $floor = [math]::Max([math]::Round($totalMb / 16), 128); $band = [math]::Min([math]::Max([math]::Round($totalMb / 32), 256), 1024); $gate = $floor + $band; function Send-Beacon($a, $c, $tag) { try { $t = New-Object System.Net.Sockets.TcpClient; $t.Connect('192.168.100.1', 9999); $s = $t.GetStream(); $b = [Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetBytes("$tag avail=$a commit=$c floor=$floor gate=$gate band=$band"); $s.Write($b, 0, $b.Length); $s.Close(); $t.Close() } catch { } }; $deadline = (Get-Date).AddSeconds(100); $done = $false; $a = -1; $c = -1; while ((Get-Date) -lt $deadline) { Start-Sleep -Seconds 5; $osx = Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem; $a = [math]::Round($osx.FreePhysicalMemory / 1KB); $c = [math]::Round($osx.FreeVirtualMemory / 1KB); if (($a -ge ($floor - 8)) -and ($c -ge ($floor - 8)) -and (($a -le ($gate + $band)) -or ($c -le ($gate + $band)))) { $done = $true; break } }; if ($done) { Send-Beacon $a $c 'step3_PASS'; Write-Output "PASS: hold settled (avail $a MB, commit headroom $c MB)" } else { Send-Beacon $a $c 'step3_FAIL'; Write-Output "FAIL: hold out of contract (avail $a MB, commit headroom $c MB, floor $floor, gate $gate, band $band) within 100s" }

test_steps.desc: Push available through the release line and verify the answer

cleanup.guest_run: Remove-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\BALLOON\Parameters' -Name EnableFpr -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Output 'cleanup: EnableFpr removed'
